reviews.author: user_001
reviews.title: Charged without warning
reviews.content: I signed up for the free trial and was charged before it ended. There was no clear notice about the renewal date or price. Very frustrating.

reviews.author: user_002
reviews.title: Good app but pricing confusing
reviews.content: The app itself is great, but I can't tell which plan I need. The comparison table is hidden behind a tooltip.

reviews.author: user_003
reviews.title: Subscription nightmare
reviews.content: I wanted to cancel but couldn't find the button. Ended up paying for another month. The subscription screen is a nightmare.

reviews.author: user_004
reviews.title: Love it
reviews.content: Works perfectly for my daily workouts. The new tracking feature is amazing.

reviews.author: user_005
reviews.title: Sync issues with watch
reviews.content: Sometimes the heart rate data from my watch doesn't sync until I restart the app. Please fix this.

reviews.author: user_006
reviews.title: Too expensive
reviews.content: Compared to competitors, the subscription is too expensive for what it offers. I might switch.

reviews.author: user_007
reviews.title: Cancel button missing
reviews.content: Where is the cancel subscription button? I looked in settings and account but couldn't find it.

reviews.author: user_008
reviews.title: Pricing is clear to me
reviews.content: I read the subscription terms and the price is clearly shown. No surprises.

reviews.author: user_009
reviews.title: Trial ended too soon
reviews.content: My trial ended after 5 days instead of 7. The app says 7-day trial but I was charged early.

reviews.author: user_010
reviews.title: Great but needs better onboarding
reviews.content: The first launch experience is overwhelming. Too many permission prompts before I can try anything.
